## Why Banks Are Crashing and the Hidden Risk in Your SIPs

**Private banks are falling despite good news — here’s why.**

Everything was going in favour of banking stocks. Valuations were attractive, and the RBI front-loaded rate cuts and injected liquidity. Yet, some of India’s top private banks, like Kotak and Axis, corrected by 10% recently. What’s happening in the private banking industry? Why are these stocks falling when the macro environment seems supportive?

**Your SIP plan might be flawed — here’s how to fix it.**

Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) are a favourite for long-term wealth creation, but many investors unknowingly make mistakes that reduce their potential returns. From incorrect fund selection to ignoring market timing, small errors can compound over time. Learn how to identify and fix the flaws in your SIP strategy to get the most out of your monthly investments.
